about: A stand-in for the description file Notes would install: its tools, what each takes and its risk. The trial builds both the enforced form and the model's native tool list from this one file.

tools.name: notes.search
tools.description: Finds notes whose text, folder or title contain the words. Gives each note's id, title, folder, the line with the words and when it changed, newest first.

words.description: A few words to look for, such as Connected or testing

tools.name: notes.read
tools.description: Gives the whole text of one note, by the id notes.search gave.

tools.name: notes.create
tools.description: Proposes a new note with this text in this folder. The person sees it on a card and decides; nothing is saved until they tap.

folder.description: The folder's name, or empty for Inbox
